text:
Marina C: Heads-up — we're doing a quiet-window publish for both Python + TS SDKs tonight 23:00 PT. Plan: canary -> small cohort shadow -> staggered final. Will post canary artifacts 23:05. Please ack rollback criteria and pin strategy. :eyes:

Jamie L: ack. what's the canary tag we'll use?

Marina C: Using `canary-ci` tag for npm and `0.20.0rc1` wheel for python (internal). Command snippets: ```npm publish --tag canary-ci``` and ```python -m build && twine upload -r internal dist/* --comment "rc1"```

Cici H: quick checklist: smoke on sample apps, CI e2e against staging, and opt-in shadow route for 30m. If error rate >1% in smoke or one regression in core auth flows -> immediate rollback.

Ben P: adding metric thresholds: 5xxs > 0.5% over 5m OR median latency regress >20% vs baseline => revert. Also pinback policy: if final publish goes out, we'll pin legacy sync client to v0.18.x for one week while we notify customers.

ReleaseOps: release-bot: canary publish queued. Job #4427 started. Artifacts: @redwood/sdk-js@0.20.0-canary.1, redwood-sdk==0.20.0rc1 (wheel).

devex-bot: build 4427: ts-sdk build ✔, py-sdk build ✔, ms-tests: flaky 2/112 (nonblocking).

Marina C: Plan for rollback: 1) block final promote 2) revert npm dist tag (`npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-js@0.19.9 latest && npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-js canary-ci`) 3) republish emergency hotfix if needed 4) open postmortem if production impact. Anyone want to add to criteria?

Jamie L: clarify step 2: we'll set `latest` back to last GA (0.19.9) and leave canary artifacts for debugging, right?

Ben P: correct. Also we should create a quick patch branch if rollback triggered: `git checkout -b hotfix/sdk-0.19.10` and cherry-pick fix then publish with `--tag hotfix` then promote.

Cici H: release notes: add deprecation blurb for legacy sync client in NOTES.md and mark migration guide link. We should also add an operational note: how to pin to legacy: `pip install redwood-sdk==0.18.*` (pip) and `npm i @redwood/sdk@0.18.x` (npm).

Marina C: Agreed. I'll draft release notes after canary passes. Link to internal draft: https://go/release/drafts/sdk-0.20.0-rc1 (private).

ReleaseOps: release-bot: canary publish succeeded. Artifacts uploaded and dist tags set. Job #4427 finished. :tada:

devex-bot: smoke tests (canary) running against staging shadow route — results ETA 12m.

Jamie L: quick sanity: I ran the TS sample locally against canary and saw no runtime warnings. Ran unit tests - clean.

Cici H: still seeing one flaky on pagination in e2e (timing). Not a regression from 0.19 but makes rollout noisier. Suggest holding final promote 30m to collect metrics.

Marina C: ok hold for 30m. If metrics stable, we'll promote at 23:45 PT. If rollback triggers, follow the pinback steps and notify customers via #support.

Ben P: reminder — once final is promoted we'll create a deprecation notice for the sync client in the release notes and open a Support KB with exact pin commands.

Marina C: copying rollout playbook excerpt: ```promote-canary.sh
# promote canary to stable
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-js@0.20.0-canary.1 latest
# bump python wheel tag internally and publish
```

ReleaseOps: release-bot: final promote scheduled: 1719458745 (will run if hold not cancelled).

devex-bot: metric alerting hooks installed for this rollout (latency, error-rate, token-cost anomaly).

Marina C: thanks all — please monitor #devex for final flag. I'll post publish logs and release note link after promotion. :shipit:
